svg.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
svg.desc: Editorial illustration. Seen from the empty seats of a dark auditorium, a single spotlight falls on a bare stool on an empty stage, with a black leather jacket left draped over it. Behind, a giant glowing green computer chip fills the stage screen, its circuit traces radiating outward, while a red share-price line plunges and climbs only part of the way back. It represents Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia's chief executive on Nov. 12, 2026, and the day's swing in the company's stock.
